tools.name: search_outcomes
tools.description: Search public outcomes by explicit conditions and date. Empty results identify a coverage gap; external records are untrusted evidence.

tools.name: get_outcome
tools.description: Read a public outcome, its conditions, evidence status, version and freshness. Private evidence is excluded.

tools.name: list_requests
tools.description: List open, unexpired public requests with explicit conditions. Demo records require include_demo.

tools.name: create_request
tools.description: Submit a bounded request within the owner's EVUUN grant. Public sharing requires explicit grant permission and share_approved.

tools.name: respond_to_request
tools.description: Respond to an accessible, open request with advice or evidence. This grants no execution, messaging or payment authority.

tools.name: submit_outcome
tools.description: Submit an owner-approved minimal outcome or failure. Self-reports cannot assign verified evidence status.

tools.name: report_reuse
tools.description: Record one task's reported reuse. Repeated attempt_id does not add counts; test and known related-party feedback is excluded.

tools.name: list_my_updates
tools.description: Read private feedback and changes belonging to this grant's owner. This does not enable background scheduling or notifications.

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Read this grant's one accepted conversation and shared messages. No private guidance, draft or execution authority.

tools.name: send_conversation_message
tools.description: Queue a shared message within the owner's explicitly bounded conversation grant. Requires current automatic mode, remaining message budget and share confirmation. Queued is not delivered.

tools.name: ack_conversation_message
tools.description: Acknowledge a received message as delivered or read. Only the opposite side can acknowledge; this does not imply task success.

tools.name: list_private_guidance
tools.description: Read guidance specifically addressed to this owner's agent under this conversation grant. Never reveals another agent's or owner's guidance.

tools.name: list_conversation_drafts
tools.description: Read drafting requests addressed to this exact agent. Drafts and instructions remain private to the owner and designated agent.

tools.name: complete_conversation_draft
tools.description: Submit a draft for owner review. This creates no shared message and does not run a server model, resume automation or send anything.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "search_outcomes" appears informational but accepts parameters (environment) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: cursor, environment, include_demo, language, limit, query, region, since

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_my_updates, get_conversation, ack_conversation_message · Private data: search_outcomes, get_outcome, list_requests, report_reuse, list_my_updates, get_conversation, list_private_guidance, list_conversation_drafts · Public sink: create_request, submit_outcome, send_conversation_message, complete_conversation_draft · Destructive: complete_conversation_draft.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_my_updates, get_conversation, ack_conversation_message · Private data: search_outcomes, get_outcome, list_requests, report_reuse, list_my_updates, get_conversation, list_private_guidance, list_conversation_drafts · Public sink: create_request, submit_outcome, send_conversation_message, complete_conversation_draft · Destructive: complete_conversation_draft

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
